name: ucalgary-cgsa-website
description: Official bilingual website of the UCalgary Chinese Graduate Students' Association (CGSA) · 卡尔加里大学中国研究生协会

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:samples: VITE_SHOW_PLACEHOLDERS=true vite build --outDir dist-samples && VITE_SHOW_PLACEHOLDERS=true vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && DIST_DIR=dist-samples VITE_SHOW_PLACEHOLDERS=true node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.preview:samples: npm run build:samples && vite preview --outDir dist-samples --port 4174 --strictPort
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
